title: Vasectomy
what: The surgeon cuts and seals the tubes that carry sperm. It is a permanent form of male birth control.
why: When a man has firmly decided not to have any more children.
duration: the procedure usually takes 20 to 40 minutes; you usually go home the same day
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners. Your doctor will decide what to do
Allergies, including to painkillers or numbing medicine
Past surgery or injury to the scrotum

prepare.title: Your decision
prepare.text: This is a permanent method. Discuss it with your doctor and, if you wish, your partner. Reversal is difficult and does not always work.

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Blood tests are usually needed. The clinic will give you a list.

prepare.title: Hygiene
prepare.text: Shower the day before. Sometimes you are asked to shave the scrotum. Check with the clinic.

prepare.title: Things to bring
prepare.text: Snug-fitting underwear. It supports the scrotum after the procedure.

bring: Someone to drive you home, if you are given a sedative
steps: The skin of the scrotum is cleaned with antiseptic
The doctor numbs the area with a shot
The tubes are reached through a small cut or puncture
The tubes are cut and sealed
The opening is stitched, or heals on its own
feel: The numbing shot causes brief pain
During the procedure, a tugging feeling
Afterward, aching and swelling for a few days
after: Rest for 1 to 2 days, with cold on the scrotum as your doctor advises
No heavy lifting or sports for about a week
Sex usually after a week, as your doctor advises
You are not protected right away. Use birth control until a semen test shows no sperm, usually after a few months
red_flags: The scrotum is very swollen, or a bruise grows quickly
Pus or redness at the cut

faq.q: Will it affect my sex life?
faq.a: No. Erections, desire, and ejaculation stay the same. Only the sperm disappears from the semen.

faq.q: When can I stop using other birth control?
faq.a: Only after a semen test shows no sperm. Your doctor will set the timing.
Sometimes surgery can reopen the tubes, but it is difficult and does not always work. So the decision should be firm.

reminders.text: Vasectomy tomorrow. Take a shower, and bring snug underwear and your documents.
